besluite.fout: 'n stuk van daardie pad word' is a loose, slightly odd way to say becoming part of the path, and it breaks from the lesson's own title and heading 'deel van die pad'.
besluite.rede: 'Deel van' is the natural fixed expression, matches the title and heading, and says exactly the same thing; no protected wording is touched.

besluite.fout: The group genitive 'in 'n sok of 'n verlengsnoer se gaatjies' makes a reader stumble, because 'se' attaches on first reading only to 'verlengsnoer'.
besluite.rede: The proposal names the same holes of the same two objects, so the rule forbids the same thing in clearer word order, and 'Daardie gaatjies' in the next item still points correctly.
One article shared across 'die draad of toestel' is correct, natural Afrikaans and reads clearly, so repeating 'die' is a lateral move.
'n Prop met meer as een sok in' is an idiomatic Afrikaans 'met ... in' construction, not an error, and a glossary definition is not reworded for style.
